title: Eleutheroside B-loaded poly (lactic-co-glycolic acid) nanoparticles protect against renal fibrosis via Smad3-dependent mechanism.
authors: Chen, Xiaohui; Liu, Qixia; Yang, Jing; Kan, Min; Jin, Rui; Pu, Tian; Yang, Yaru; Xing, Tian; Meng, Xiaoming; Zang, Hongmei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究PLGA纳米颗粒负载刺五加苷B通过Smad3依赖机制抗肾纤维化，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Although renal fibrosis is a common complication of chronic kidney disease (CKD), effective options for its treatment are currently limited. In this study, we evaluated the renal protective effect and possible mechanism of eleutheroside B. In order to solve the allergic reactions, side effects, and low oral bioavailability of eleutheroside B, we successfully prepared PLGA (poly [lactic-co-glycolic acid])-eleutheroside B nanoparticles (NPs) with the diameter of about 128 nm. In vitro and in vivo results showed that eleutheroside B could inhibit expression levels of alpha-smooth muscle actin (alpha-SMA) and collagen I. Molecular docking results showed that eleutheroside B bound to Smad3 and significantly decreased the expression of phospho-Smad3 (p-Smad3). Silencing Smad3 reversed the fibrotic protective effect of eleutheroside B in HK2 cells. Furthermore, small animal imaging showed that NPs can selectively accumulate in the UUO kidneys of mice, and retention time reached as long as 7 days. In conclusion, our results suggested that eleutheroside B is a potential drug to protect renal fibrosis and PLGA-eleutheroside B NPs could facilitate specific targeted therapy for renal fibrosis.
abstract_zh: 尽管肾纤维化是慢性肾脏病（chronic kidney disease, CKD）的常见并发症，但目前有效的治疗选择有限。在本研究中，我们评估了刺五加苷B的肾脏保护作用及其可能机制。为解决刺五加苷B的过敏反应、副作用及口服生物利用度低的问题，我们成功制备了直径约128 nm的PLGA（聚乳酸-羟基乙酸共聚物）-刺五加苷B纳米颗粒（nanoparticles, NPs）。体外和体内结果表明，刺五加苷B能抑制α-平滑肌肌动蛋白（alpha-smooth muscle actin, alpha-SMA）和I型胶原蛋白的表达水平。分子对接结果显示，刺五加苷B与Smad3结合，并显著降低磷酸化Smad3（phospho-Smad3, p-Smad3）的表达。沉默Smad3可逆转刺五加苷B在HK2细胞中的纤维化保护作用。此外，小动物成像显示，NPs能选择性积聚在小鼠UUO肾脏中，滞留时间长达7天。总之，我们的结果表明，刺五加苷B是保护肾纤维化的潜在药物，PLGA-刺五加苷B NPs可促进肾纤维化的特异性靶向治疗。
